title: designfuchen/word-atlas
why_read: An illustrated IELTS vocabulary app with spaced-repetition review, a nicely executed product but not a technically novel contribution.
analysis: Word Atlas is a vocabulary-learning app covering thousands of IELTS words with audio and images, using the FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling algorithm. The engineering here is mostly about content curation and UI polish rather than any new technique, since FSRS itself is an existing open algorithm. It's a nice resource for English learners but holds limited broader technical interest for a software engineering audience.
